VistoGallery is local-first and offline by design. Ideas that need an account, a
cloud service or telemetry do not fit the project, however useful they are elsewhere.
-->

## Which part of the app?

<!-- Library, Albums, Viewer, Edit, Duplicates, Batch, Hidden, Video player, Settings, import/scanning, keyboard, other -->

## The problem

What are you trying to do that the app makes hard or impossible today? A concrete example from your own library is more useful than an abstract request.

## The solution you would like

What should happen instead? If it is a UI change, a rough sketch or a screenshot of a similar app helps.

## Alternatives you have considered

Other ways to solve it, including what you do now (another app, a script, the Finder).

## Who else would benefit?

Is this specific to your workflow (a particular camera, an external drive, a huge library) or something most users would hit?

## Additional context

Anything else: related issues, how the feature would interact with privacy or the catalog, whether you would be willing to work on it.
